## Before submitting

- [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt).
- [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes.
- [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below.
- [ ] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)). I cannot set labels on this repository; suggested: `orig-external`, `cat-perf-bug`, `area:global_attention`, `mod-frost`.

## Affected area

Benchmarks or performance

## Summary

The NVFP4 QAT backward's Triton route uses 64x64 tiles, 8 warps and 2 / 3 stages only for noncausal graphs on cc 10.0 (`optimized_sm100`). Every other supported part, cc 10.3 included, uses 32x32 tiles, 4 warps and 3 / 3 stages. On a B300 the 64x64 launch is about 2x faster, with bitwise-identical gradients, so this PR applies it to cc 10.3 as well. Causal graphs and the SM120 parts keep the 32x32 launch.

Changes:

- `sdpa/bwd/qat/api.py`: `capability in ((10, 0), (10, 3))` instead of `== (10, 0)`.
- The docs sentence about the launch.
- A metadata-only test pinning the launch tuple on modeled cc 10.0 / 10.3 / 10.3 causal / 12.0.

This is independent of #2102, which admits cc 10.3 to the FROST backend. With #2102, `auto` selects FROST on cc 10.3 for the declarations FROST serves, and Triton remains the route for the rest (B > 1, causal, lengths not divisible by 256) and for `backend="triton"`.

## Why

The tile choice was tuned on cc 10.0 only. cc 10.3 runs the same Triton kernels and gains the same way.

## Related issues

None found.

## API and compatibility impact

None. Same outputs (bitwise on the measured cases), same workspace; only the Triton launch configuration on cc 10.3 changes.

## Testing

B300 (cc 10.3), develop `64ed3dfe`, torch 2.14.1+cu130, Triton 3.8.0. Both launch configurations were run on the same inputs (B1, D128, BF16, noncausal, `backend="triton"`), using `benchmark_backends.py`'s inputs and timing: three backwards per CUDA graph, five ABBA / BAAB rounds, median.

| Heads | Sequence | 32x32 ms (develop) | 64x64 ms (this PR) | Speedup | dQ / dK / dV |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | 8192 | 1.9382 | 0.9818 | 1.97x | bitwise equal |
| 3 | 32768 | 26.4785 | 13.3132 | 1.99x | bitwise equal |
| 12 | 8192 | 6.7415 | 3.4610 | 1.95x | bitwise equal |
| 12 | 32768 | 102.0098 | 49.8046 | 2.05x | bitwise equal |

`python -m pytest sdpa/cutedsl/test_nvfp4_attention_qat_backward.py sdpa/cutedsl/test_nvfp4_attention_qat_dispatch.py` on this branch (B300): 18 passed, 11 skipped. The skipped cases are the FROST ones, which decline cc 10.3 on develop (#2102 admits it), so the Triton backward cases ran the 64x64 launch on cc 10.3. The new `test_triton_launch_config_per_part` pins the launch tuple for modeled cc 10.0, 10.3, 10.3 causal and 12.0.

Not run on cc 10.0, where the launch is unchanged.

@@ -35,8 +35,8 @@ fully masked tiles while retaining the elementwise mask on the diagonal.
 The local-scale conversion uses precise division so exact E2M1 midpoints
 preserve round-to-nearest-even; no tolerance relaxation is required.
 The production
-non-causal SM100 configuration uses 64 by 64 tiles; other supported Blackwell
-configurations use 32 by 32 tiles.
+non-causal SM100 and SM103 configurations use 64 by 64 tiles; other supported
+Blackwell configurations use 32 by 32 tiles.
 
 ## Installation

@@ -196,7 +196,8 @@ def check_support(self) -> bool:
             f"NVFP4 QAT Triton requires {self._workspace_bytes} workspace bytes, exceeding workspace_limit_bytes={self.workspace_limit_bytes}",
         )
 
-        optimized_sm100 = capability == (10, 0) and not self.is_causal and seqlen_kv % 16 == 0
+        # 64x64 tiles: about 2x faster than 32x32 on cc 10.3 too (B300, H3 / H12 at 8K / 32K).
+        optimized_sm100 = capability in ((10, 0), (10, 3)) and not self.is_causal and seqlen_kv % 16 == 0
         block_size = 64 if optimized_sm100 else 32
         num_warps = 8 if optimized_sm100 else 4
         fallback_stages = 2 if capability[0] == 12 and max(seqlen_q, seqlen_kv) >= 8192 else 3

@@ -72,6 +72,21 @@ def test_auto_architecture_selection_metadata_only(monkeypatch, capability):
         Nvfp4AttentionQatBackward(*inputs, backend="frost").check_support()
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "capability,is_causal,launch",
+    [((10, 0), False, (64, 64, 8, 2, 3)), ((10, 3), False, (64, 64, 8, 2, 3)), ((10, 3), True, (32, 32, 4, 3, 3)), ((12, 0), False, (32, 32, 4, 3, 3))],
+    ids=["sm100", "sm103", "sm103_causal", "sm120"],
+)
+def test_triton_launch_config_per_part(monkeypatch, capability, is_causal, launch):
+    """The Triton route's tiles, metadata only: 64x64 / 8 warps on the noncausal SM100-family parts, 32x32 / 4 warps elsewhere."""
+    from cudnn import Nvfp4AttentionQatBackward
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(torch.cuda, "get_device_capability", lambda *args: capability)
+    op = Nvfp4AttentionQatBackward(*_declaration(), backend="triton", is_causal=is_causal)
+    assert op.check_support() and op.selected_backend == "triton"
+    assert op._launch_config == launch
+
